mapper.select: select m.member_seq, m.login_id, m.name, m.nickname, m.phone, m.email, m.gender, m.birth_date, m.zipcode, m.address1, m.address2, m.created_at, (select max(pi.file_url) keep (dense_rank first order by pi.sort_order) from profile_image pi where pi.member_seq = m.member_seq) as profile_image_url from member m where m.member_seq = #{memberSeq}
mapper.update: update member set nickname = #{nickname}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, zipcode = #{zipcode}, address1 = #{address1}, address2 = #{address2} where member_seq = #{memberSeq}
